Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of LLY.
We delivered record revenue of $26.6 billion this quarter, representing 14% year-over-year growth.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.

Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1675 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Revenue guidance of $26.6 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
